name: Nexatel
tagline: Building Kerala's network backbone, one fibre at a time.
description: Nexatel Private Limited is a specialist IT networking and telecom infrastructure company based in Kerala, India. We design, supply and install enterprise networks, structured cabling, fibre optic systems, telecom civil works and security systems for corporate clients and large infrastructure projects.
shortDescription: Nexatel Private Limited is a specialist company in telecom systems, electrical installations, network cabling and IT hardware supply and installation in India. We are headquartered in Kerala and currently delivering major projects across the state.

offices.address: PEEDIKAYIL BUILDING, KODIKUTTUMALA, ASOKAPURAM, ALUVA, ERNAKULAM, 683101, KERALA, INDIA

mission: To be a trusted partner for telecom, electrical and IT networking infrastructure in India, delivering reliable, high quality systems that help our clients run smoother operations and reach more communities.
vision: To set the standard for seamless telecom and IT services in India, and grow alongside the clients and sectors we serve.

values.title: Integrity
values.description: We do what we say we will, and we say what we mean. No hidden line items, no shifted blame.

values.title: Expertise
values.description: Twenty five years of fibre and networking experience sits behind every project, from the survey to the sign off.

values.title: Teamwork
values.description: Our engineers work as part of your team, not separate from it. Decisions are made together, in the open.

values.title: Client focus
values.description: Your timeline, your site constraints and your budget shape the plan. We adjust to your operation, not the other way around.

areasOfFocus.title: Corporate enterprises

areasOfFocus.title: Telecom and ISP
areasOfFocus.description: Service providers building fibre backbones, FTTH rollouts and last mile networks across Kerala and South India.

areasOfFocus.title: Oil, Gas and Energy
areasOfFocus.description: Field networks, hazardous area cabling and industrial CCTV for refineries, terminals and power plants.

areasOfFocus.title: Defence and Shipyards

areasOfFocus.title: Campus networks
areasOfFocus.description: Universities, hospitals and large institutional campuses with multi-building cabling, wireless coverage and access control.
